<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Extract brand identity from website"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/brand/extract"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Extract comprehensive brand identity information from a given website URL.
The service crawls the website, collects assets (images, CSS, fonts), and analyzes them to produce a structured brand kit.

### Extracted Information
- **Brand Name**: Detected from page titles, Open Graph metadata, and header elements
- **Logos**: Identified from header images, favicons, and OG images with confidence scoring
- **Fonts**: Extracted from CSS files and Google Fonts references
- **Colors**: Extracted from CSS and key images, clustered into primary/secondary/accent roles
- **Key Images**: Hero images, product photos, banners (excluding logos)
- **Brand Summary**: Generated from OG descriptions and about page content

This is a **synchronous** operation — the response is returned once extraction is complete.
Processing time depends on the website size and number of pages crawled.

> ⚠️ **Anti-Crawling Warning**
>
> Some websites enforce anti-crawling / anti-scraping policies (e.g. via `robots.txt`, WAF rules, rate limiting, or bot detection).
> Attempting to extract brand information from such websites may result in:
> - **Temporary IP blocking** — the service's outbound IP may be rate-limited or temporarily banned by the target website.
> - **Permanent IP blocking** — repeated requests may cause the target website to permanently block the service's IP address.
> - **Incomplete or empty results** — if the website blocks the crawler, extracted data may be missing or incomplete.
>
> Please ensure you have the right to crawl the target website before using this endpoint.

### Example (Development)
```bash
curl --location 'https://api-mico-gen-ai.dev-craft.mico.one/brand/extract' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"url": "https://example.com"}'
```

### Example (Staging)
```bash
curl -k --location 'https://mico.gen.ai.stg-craft.mico.one/brand/extract' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"url": "https://example.com"}'
```
